items.name: base
items.title: Base
items.description: Tokens, color scales, theme, fonts, reset and focus ring every component builds on.
items.docs: Needs the StyleX compiler with an `@/*` alias. `@import` lib/constella/base.css from the stylesheet the root route or layout links. Toggle dark mode with a `.dark` class on <html>. Setup per framework: https://constella.aayush.cv/docs/installation/index.md. Every docs page: https://constella.aayush.cv/llms.txt

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: A callout with an icon, a title, a description and an action, its status on the icon.

items.name: alert-dialog
items.title: Alert Dialog
items.description: A dialog that confirms an action, on the dialog's surface.

items.name: approval
items.title: Approval
items.description: A card asking to allow a tool call, with its arguments and answer buttons.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: A small label in the button's five variants, with icons, a spinner or a link.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Five variants for every level of emphasis, in four sizes, each with an icon-only square.

items.name: code-block
items.title: Code Block
items.description: Code in a tray, with a title, actions, line numbers and diffs. The app highlights it.

items.name: copy-button
items.title: Copy Button
items.description: A button that copies text and shows a tick for a moment.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: A centered surface over a dimmed page, for a decision that needs full attention.

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: A thin, unhurried arc that says something is working.

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: Quiet notifications that stack, follow a promise and swipe away.
items.docs: Render <Toaster /> once near the root, then call toast.add({ title }) from anywhere. Usage: https://constella.aayush.cv/docs/components/toast/index.md

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: A bordered surface that groups related content, with a header, content and footer.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: A small square that fills with the accent when checked.

items.name: collapsible
items.title: Collapsible
items.description: A section that opens and closes, growing to its height.

items.name: command
items.title: Command
items.description: A searchable command list on Base UI's inline Autocomplete, inline or in a dialog.

items.name: toggle
items.title: Toggle
items.description: A button that stays pressed, filling while on.

items.name: toggle-group
items.title: Toggle Group
items.description: Toggles that sit apart or join into one row.

items.name: segmented-control
items.title: Segmented Control
items.description: One pick among a few, marked by a pill that slides to it.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: A small inverted label that names what's under the pointer.

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: Lays out a control with its label, description and error, and links them.

items.name: kbd
items.title: Kbd
items.description: A small keycap for a shortcut, in text, buttons and tooltips.

items.name: text
items.title: Text
items.description: Body copy on the type scale, in three sizes.

items.name: heading
items.title: Heading
items.description: A heading whose rank and size are set apart, on the heading scale.

items.name: caption
items.title: Caption
items.description: Small text for metadata and labels, in four sizes.

items.name: link
items.title: Link
items.description: A link inside running text, underlined.

items.name: code
items.title: Code
items.description: Code inside running text, in mono on a fill.

items.name: label
items.title: Label
items.description: Names a control, in the same voice for every field.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: A single-line text box that links to its Field.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: A multi-line text box that grows with its content and links to its Field.

items.name: input-group
items.title: Input Group
items.description: Icons, text, keys and buttons set inside an input or textarea's box.

items.name: sheet
items.title: Sheet
items.description: A dialog that slides in from an edge, for side panels on narrow screens.

items.name: side-panel
items.title: Side Panel
items.description: A full-height, non-modal panel that opens beside the page, for details, a form or anything else.

items.name: sidebar
items.title: Sidebar
items.description: App navigation beside the page that collapses to icons or out of view, and opens as a sheet on narrow screens.

items.name: settings-dialog
items.title: Settings Dialog
items.description: A dialog laid out as a nav beside a page, for settings with several pages.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: A pulsing placeholder for content still loading.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: A thin track and a solid thumb, with its label and value above.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Views of the same content, with an indicator that slides to the active tab.

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: A hairline that divides content, across or down.

items.name: button-group
items.title: Button Group
items.description: Joins buttons, inputs and text into one control, across or down.

items.name: swap-icon
items.title: Swap Icon
items.description: Cross-fades one icon into another in place.

items.name: swap-text
items.title: Swap Text
items.description: Morphs one label into another in place.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: Turns a setting on or off, in two sizes, beside a label or in a card.

items.name: scroll-area
items.title: Scroll Area
items.description: A scrolling region with an overlay scrollbar that shows while in use.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: Picks one option from a list, on an input's surface, with groups and scrolling.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: Rich content in a floating panel, opened from a button, with a header and room for a form.

items.name: calendar
items.title: Calendar
items.description: A month grid for picking a day or a range, with the selection in the info color.

items.name: date-range-picker
items.title: Date Range Picker
items.description: A button showing a range of days, opening a two-month calendar with optional presets beside it.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: Dropdown Menu
items.description: A menu of actions from a button, with groups, toggles, choices, submenus and filtering.

items.name: meter
items.title: Meter
items.description: A bar or an icon-sized ring for a measurement against a limit, like usage against a quota.

items.name: message
items.title: Message
items.description: A user's message in a bubble, or an answer as the page, with an actions row.

items.name: message-scroller
items.title: Message Scroller
items.description: Scrolls a conversation, sticking to the newest message, on shadcn's message-scroller.

items.name: questionnaire
items.title: Questionnaire
items.description: Questions asked one at a time, with choices, a freeform answer and skips, on shadcn's questionnaire.

items.name: hover-card
items.title: Hover Card
items.description: A popover that previews a link while the pointer rests on it.

items.name: prompt-input
items.title: Prompt Input
items.description: The chat composer on an input group: grows with its text, submits on Enter, turns into Stop while streaming, and opens a command list over itself.

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: A bar for how far along a task is, with an optional label and value.

items.name: radio-group
items.title: Radio Group
items.description: Picks one option out of a few, beside labels, with descriptions or as cards.

items.name: empty
items.title: Empty
items.description: An empty state with media, a title, a description and actions.

items.name: item
items.title: Item
items.description: A row with media, a title, a description and actions, alone or in a list.

items.name: breadcrumb
items.title: Breadcrumb
items.description: A trail of links to the pages above the current one.

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: Rows of data with a header, footer and caption, divided by faint edges.

items.name: data-table
items.title: Data Table
items.description: Renders a TanStack Table as a Table, virtualized, with sorting, selection, an action bar, pagination, column visibility and TanStack Query states.

items.name: chart
items.title: Chart
items.description: Renders a TanStack Charts definition in the theme's series palette, with a tooltip and a legend that toggles series.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: A user's picture with a fallback, a status badge, and groups that overlap.

items.name: shimmer
items.title: Shimmer
items.description: A slow sweep of light across text still being worked on.

items.name: markdown
items.title: Markdown
items.description: An answer's markdown: prose, lists, quotes, tables and code blocks with a copy button.

items.name: marker
items.title: Marker
items.description: A note in a conversation: a status, a system line, or a labeled break.

items.name: scroll-fade
items.title: Scroll Fade
items.description: Fades a scroller's edges while there's more content past them.

items.name: attachment
items.title: Attachment
items.description: A file or image with its name, details, upload state and actions.

items.name: trace
items.title: Trace
items.description: The steps an agent takes, on one rail, each with a status, what it acted on and what it found.

items.name: citation
items.title: Citation
items.description: A source's pill in an answer, opening a card with its publication, headline and date.

items.name: model-picker
items.title: Model Picker
items.description: A searchable list of models in a popover, with the highlighted model's details beside it.

items.name: suggestions
items.title: Suggestions
items.description: Starter prompts as a scrolling row of pills, for an empty chat.
